title: Finite sphere configurations
target_statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. A configuration is a function from \(\operatorname{Fin}N\) to the sphere. The empty product \(N=0\) is allowed.
